title: Gauntlet & Rampart
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Collection. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Gauntlet: top-down dungeon crawler (arcade classic).
Rampart: build walls, place cannons, sink ships.
widgets.label: Two games

widgets.text: Health drains over time; food refills it.
widgets.label: Gauntlet

widgets.text:
1 Place cannons in your castle walls
2 Battle: fire on ships
3 Rebuild: patch walls with puzzle pieces
A castle not enclosed at the end of rebuild is lost.
widgets.label: Phases

widgets.text:
Shoot the generators first.
Do not shoot food and potions.
widgets.label: Gauntlet

widgets.text: Enclose extra castles to earn more cannons.
widgets.label: Rampart

widgets.text:
Gauntlet: endless maze levels with exits to later floors.
Rampart: rounds of build/battle/repair.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Both games keep score tables: aim for higher floors/rounds.
widgets.label: High scores

widgets.text:
Gauntlet: reach deeper levels.
Rampart: survive the rounds without losing your castles.
widgets.label: Goal
